surfaces.title: Pages of the site, with the scripts of their demos and the summaries of the standard packages
surfaces.notes: The source files hold the English only; a group that names a context, <en ctx=NAME>, has the key NAME|English. site/build.py refuses a translation written beside the English, which scripts/i18n/migrate_site.py moves into the catalogs. The timeline is counted in site-timeline.

surfaces.title: Shared messages of the site and of the standard's pages
Milestones of the site's timeline
One-sentence summaries of releases, for the timeline
surfaces.notes: Released notes are not changed afterwards; the summaries of standard releases are in the messages of their spec-* tags and are not counted here.

surfaces.title: Interface of the viewers, with the desktop app's native menus and file dialogs
surfaces.notes: The scan finds the texts written in m("…"), m`…`, tr("…") (a text that m() translates where it is shown, through a variable), the labels of commands.json, the static text of index.html and the desktop app's menu::text(…, "…"). Every text of the interface is written in one of these forms, so a catalog entry the scan does not find is one the interface no longer has.

surfaces.where: apps/desktop/tauri.conf.json (the NSIS installer in English and Chinese, from Tauri's own texts; the MSI in English only), the short description in tauri.linux.conf.json and tauri.macos.conf.json, the file associations

surfaces.title: Alias package of the standard series 0.3
surfaces.notes: Part of the language (16.5), not a translation of the interface: a file written with these words reads as one written with the English ones. Whether a language has an alias package is decided with the standard. no_alias lists the names that keep their English spelling on purpose.

surfaces.title: Titles and descriptions of the entries of the gallery
surfaces.notes: Each entry has its translations in its own entries/<id>.json. Read with --online.

surfaces.title: Summaries of the public packages
surfaces.notes: In metadata.json of rnl-packages, copied into each record of the immutable catalog; step 5 of decision 0015 keeps the summaries of other languages outside the record. Read with --online.

surfaces.title: Diagnostics of the core and the command line, and its usage text
surfaces.reason: The standard leaves the wording and language of diagnostics open (7.6). They are free English text without codes, and tools, tests, documents and agents read and quote them as they are; the viewers show them as they are.

surfaces.title: The skill package for agents, skills/rnl/
surfaces.reason: Read by agents, and in English only; its guide to the language is a copy of the English short guide.

surfaces.title: docs/, the READMEs of crates, apps, packages and scripts, CONTRIBUTING.md
surfaces.reason: Documents for developers, in English only, docs/rnl-toolchain-architecture.md included.

surfaces.title: Bodies of the release notes
surfaces.reason: Released notes are records; only their one-sentence summary is translated (release-summaries).

surfaces.title: Comments in code and in package files, the tags of the gallery
surfaces.reason: Code comments are in English; the comments of rnl-zh are in Chinese and stay so. Gallery tags are shown as written in every language.
